An analysis by G. Elliott Morris found that primary election polls miss by an average of 13 points, and prediction markets were also shown to have failed on the Hong result in Wisconsin. El-Sayed's historic nomination as the first Muslim nominated by a major party for U.S. Senate has triggered anti-Muslim vitriol on multiple fronts, tempering elation among Muslim Americans.
